_help: AI hosts of the presenter videos (presenter.py). A host is a generated adult who talks to camera in 'you' form: never a customer, never an invented purchase / use / result. master = the reference picture every scene still of this host is made from (same face, same hair, same earrings); look = how the prompts describe her; voice = what the take prompts ask her voice to be (Kling makes the voice: takes of one host sound alike when asked the same).
